verdict.rationale: Smithery is an MCP registry and hosting platform, so this axis applies. A probe reports an official MCP server documented at /docs/use/connect, and the docs describe Smithery-hosted MCPs that deep links auto-configure in clients, plus service tokens that expose Smithery to AI agents. However, the cited docs mainly describe a REST gateway to third-party servers rather than a clearly specified first-party Smithery MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Smithery's own MCP server endpoint and the tools it exposes, agent setup instructions for it, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://smithery.ai/docs/use/connect
Deep links provide a seamless way to integrate Smithery MCPs into supported clients.
Service tokens let you safely expose Smithery to browsers, mobile apps, and AI agents without leaking your API key.
Uplink exposes an MCP server running on any machine as a regular Smithery connection.
